pass75_dimension_presentation_contract.purpose: Normalize presentation-facing dimension UI/help text without removing legacy/source UI.
rules: H toggles universal/Core HUD only while no native dimension is active.
Inside native artifact dimensions, H toggles only the dimension legacy/source UI.
Legacy/source UI defaults hidden for Code Red Vector, Etch-Line, Fractured Dimension, Holo Campaign, Holo Conquest, and Vector Wars.
Zonez is excluded because its visible UI is part of its gameplay loop.
Every native artifact status line should say ESC / 0 RETURN TO HOLOVERSE.
Visible native artifact help text should not imply standalone quit, fullscreen, or pause-menu ownership.
